name: DDM GE validator worker
description: Runs Great Expectations suites against uploaded datasets and posts results on-chain.

code.artifact_hash_note: The on-chain ValidatorsRegistry requires a bytes32. Provide VALIDATOR_CODE_HASH=0x... in .env or it will be derived as keccak(description|uri).

expectations.notes: Suites must be provided in canonical JSON (stable key order, no whitespace differences).
